Name: Detailed Machine Statuses
Author: ParsnipGrower
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#999999]You can finally see when your machines will finish processing! Will that gold bar be done in 1 hour or 5? How many days until your casks are done? Wonder no more! With Detailed Machine Statuses, you can see exactly when every machine that processes an item into something else will finish. You can also see what it is working on, in case you forgot what exactly you put in there.[/color]

[b][size=4]Installation instructions[/size][/b]
[color=#999999]Just download and unzip into the mod folder like most mods. Works with Generic Mod Config Manager (GMCM) if you have that installed, or you can manually configure through the config.json file in the mod directory. This also supports Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE) or other mods that add new machines.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#999999]View when machines will finish and what they are working on. That's it really, it's a fairly simple mod, but useful![/color]

[color=#999999]There are a bunch of settings available to customize the size of the overlays and location of them in case they are in a poor location for whatever machine you are using. You can customize the overlay for each machine individually. This is especially useful if you are using mods that alter what the machines look like.[/color]

[color=#999999]There are key bindings for enabling the overlay text and the overlay image separately. The defaults are G to toggle the text and H to toggle the image of what will be produced. You can also press J to dump the detailed information to the SMAPI logging console. You can update the key bindings for all of these in the settings.[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#999999]Just requires SMAPI, and supports GMCM and SVE. Should support any other mod that adds machines. Report bugs if something doesn't work.[/color]
